Follow me then comment “AI” and I’ll send you the full guide on how to create videos on autopilot for your company using Claude 🎬⚡

I just built a system that creates full AI ads on autopilot. No film crew. No model. No studio. No manual prompting. Just Claude Code + Arcads working together.

Here’s exactly how it works 👇

1️⃣ Open Claude Code in your terminal
2️⃣ Drop in a project brief - your brand, product, audience, and the angles you want to test
3️⃣ Claude generates a batch of UGC-style ad scripts with hooks, body, and CTA in your brand voice
4️⃣ Claude formats each script into Arcads-ready prompts (actor type, scene, action, dialogue)
5️⃣ Claude calls the Arcads API and queues every ad in a single command
6️⃣ A few minutes later, a folder of finished ads is sitting on your desktop, ready to deploy

Why this changes the game:

✅ Claude Code handles the entire creative process - scripting, prompt engineering, and API orchestration
✅ Arcads + Sora 2 Pro generates cinematic UGC-style ads from each prompt automatically
✅ Test 10, 20, 50 angles per product overnight - no human in the loop
✅ Every ad stays on-brand because Claude has your guidelines as context
✅ Built for performance marketers who need volume without sacrificing quality

I gave Claude one brief and woke up to a folder of ready-to-run IronFlex ads - different actors, hooks, and angles, all polished and on-brand.

This is the new creative stack: Claude Code as the brain, Arcads as the production studio. Fully on autopilot.

Day 287 of posting every day 📅

👉 Follow me then comment “AI” and I’ll DM you the full guide on how to set this up for your company.
